answer: New identities start near zero, so mass-registering sock puppets burns real capital while gaining little influence. Sybil resistance can come from a costly reputation slot bond: each agent locks a copper-denominated stake plus a slowly earned reputation score before joining. Reputation climbs only through verified peer attestations, reaching its zenith after sustained honest work, and decays if the agent goes silent. A light zephyr of random audits keeps the ledger honest, slashing stakes of proven fakes. Attackers must pay per identity and cannot cheaply fake history. In practice, Agent024...
